newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on strong fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on strong fundamentals.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices continued to surge at the close with the underlying firm fundamentals continuing to boost sentiment. Trading remained active with buying emerged after Mar futures broke the 1,235 ringgit. Next resistance for March contract is 1,245 and support 1,230.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Followed the firmer futures market.

A higher December 1-15 palm oil export continued to underpin sentiment, they said. Cargo surveyor SGS (M) Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for December 1-15 at 406,924 tonnes compared with 298,862 tonnes for November 1-15.
The firm market also reflected on speculation that soyoil futures in Chicago market may follow the palm trend today.
Trading continued active with brisk technical buying interest emerged when March futures rose above 1,235 ringgit level. At the close, the contract was up 11 ringgit at 1,242 ringgit ($491.98).
Traders said the contract's next resistance is 1,250 ringgit and support level is 1,225 ringgit.
Turnover was 3,663 lots against 2,230 on Monday.

Among physical, Dec (south) saw offers at 1,265 ringgit against bids at 1,260 after trading at 1,255 and 1,262.50. Dec (central) was offered at 1,257.50 and bids at 1,252.50 with earlier trades of 1,250 and 1,255.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,265 and bids at 1,255 with earlier trades at 1,255 and 1,262.50, Jan (central) at 1,260 and bids at 1,257.50.
